Websites & digital

Make your next customer’s first step easy.

A useful website explains what you do, works on a phone, and makes getting in touch straightforward. Start fresh, improve the site you have, or connect the tools your business needs online.

How I can help

Website builds

Plan the pages, navigation, content, and contact path around your business. The scope can include booking or payment integrations when you need them.

Discuss website builds
Website updates & care

Refresh content, resolve layout issues, or improve an existing site. For ongoing care, we’ll agree on the tasks and update arrangements.

Discuss website updates & care
Search engine optimization

Review page titles, content, structure, and technical issues that affect how your business appears in search. Rankings are never guaranteed.

Discuss search engine optimization
Google Business Profile

Set up or update your business information, services, and links. You retain ownership of your business account.

Discuss google business profile
Social media & marketing

Plan and prepare content for your audience and channels. We’ll define the content, posting responsibilities, and any paid advertising budget together.

Discuss social media & marketing

Built around your business

  • Page structure and content shaped around what customers need.
  • Layouts that work across phones, tablets, and computers.
  • A walkthrough of the finished work and how updates will be handled.

We’ll agree on pages, features, content responsibilities, and ongoing support before work begins. Domain, hosting, and software costs are discussed as part of that scope.

A useful first message

Your business, what you offer, and what you want customers to do next. An existing site link is helpful if you have one.

Business technology

Get the tools behind your business working together.

From the front counter to the back office, the right setup should make work easier. Get help choosing, configuring, and connecting the systems you use every day.

How I can help

Business email & domains

Connect your domain, configure professional email, and set it up on the devices you use. Domain and email subscriptions remain part of your business accounts.

Discuss business email & domains
Booking & payment systems

Set up scheduling, payment links, or a point-of-sale workflow. We’ll check the agreed customer journey and explain any provider costs.

Office setup & Wi-Fi

Connect workstations, Wi-Fi, printers, and scanners around how your space is used. On-site visits are available throughout the county.

Discuss office setup & wi-fi
Business software setup

Configure everyday business or inventory software around your workflow, including initial settings and a walkthrough of the setup.

Discuss business software setup
Data transfers & backups

Move files between devices or set up a backup routine. We’ll discuss what needs to move, where it will be stored, and how you’ll access it.

Discuss data transfers & backups
Digital signage & QR menus

Prepare digital information, displays, or QR-linked menus with a clear way to keep the content current.

Discuss digital signage & qr menus

A setup you can actually use

  • A plan based on your workflow, equipment, and existing accounts.
  • Configuration and checks for the tools included in your project.
  • A practical walkthrough so you know how the setup works.

Software subscriptions, hardware purchases, and account ownership are agreed with you before setup. Existing tools are considered before suggesting a change.

The tools or equipment you use now, what needs to connect, and where the setup will be used.

Repairs & tech help

Let’s figure out what’s wrong—and what makes sense.

A cracked screen, a slow computer, or a device that won’t cooperate can stop your day. Explain what’s happening and we’ll work out the next step, including whether a repair is practical.

How I can help

Phone & device repairs

Screen, charging-port, and other device repairs depend on the model and available parts. Send the model and symptoms to discuss the options.

Discuss phone & device repairs
Computer repairs & upgrades

Troubleshoot faults or slowdowns and assess suitable component replacements or upgrades. We’ll discuss repair value and compatibility before buying parts.

Discuss computer repairs & upgrades
Virus & malware cleanup

Investigate suspicious behavior, unwanted software, and browser problems. We’ll discuss the findings and practical next steps for using the device.

Discuss virus & malware cleanup
Device & software setup

Get help with a new device, software installation, personal file transfers, or a setting that’s causing trouble. Remote help may suit some issues.

Discuss device & software setup

A clear path from problem to next step

  • An assessment of the issue and the available options.
  • Cost, parts, and scope discussed before a repair proceeds.
  • Checks of the agreed repair or setup and a walkthrough with you.

Repair options and timing depend on the model, condition, and parts. Remote help, customer visits, and arranged drop-off are available; the right approach depends on the problem.

A useful first message

The device model, symptoms, and any recent changes. Keep passwords and sensitive files out of your inquiry.

Photography & media

Give your work something worth showing.

How I can help

Professional photography

Business, product, and real estate photos planned for their intended use. The shoot location, shot list, editing, and delivered files are agreed in advance.

Discuss professional photography
Video & YouTube content

Editing & promotional media

Content with a clear purpose

Helpful answers

Before you get started

How much will it cost?

Pricing depends on the project or device and the work involved. Share a few details, and we can discuss the scope and a quote before getting started.

Can you repair my phone or computer?

Repair options depend on the model, the problem, and the parts needed. Include the device model and a description of what is happening so we can work out the next step.

Where do you offer help?

I serve all of Fremont County, Wyoming. Remote help, visits to your home or business, and arranged device drop-off are available. Call first to discuss what you need and arrange the right approach.

Can I drop off a device?

Yes, by arrangement. There isn’t a public storefront at this time. Call before bringing a device so we can agree on the handoff and discuss the issue.

What if I need something that isn’t listed?

Ask. If it involves a website, technology, photography, or video, tell me what you have in mind. I’ll be clear about whether it’s something I can take on.
